thinking_type.description: Prompt optimization mode: 'enabled' to optimize, 'disabled' to turn off, 'auto' for model decision
thinking_type.title: Thinking Type

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to be used for the generation. Limited to 2048 UTF-8 encoded bytes. Because the limit counts bytes rather than characters, emoji and non-Latin or accented characters (which use multiple bytes each) can push a visually short prompt over the cap.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

seed.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model
            will output the same video every time.
seed.title: Seed

duration.description: The duration of the generated video in seconds. v6 supports values from 1 to 15 seconds
duration.title: Duration

generate_multi_clip_switch.description: Enable multi-clip generation with dynamic camera changes
generate_multi_clip_switch.title: Generate Multi Clip Switch

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

resolution.description: The resolution of the generated video
resolution.title: Resolution

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

prompt.description: Text prompt for the video generation. Limited to 2048 UTF-8 encoded bytes. Because the limit counts bytes rather than characters, emoji and non-Latin or accented characters (which use multiple bytes each) can push a visually short prompt over the cap.
prompt.title: Prompt

style.description: The style of the generated video
style.title: Style

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size
